description: Source code for handling UL-DCCH messages in 5G NR RRC protocol, including classes and methods for message type selection, serialization, and JSON conversion.

classes.name: ul_dcch_msg_type_c
classes.description: Represents the choice of message types for UL-DCCH messages, including methods for setting, serialization, and JSON conversion.

classes.name: ul_dcch_msg_type_c::c1_c_
classes.description: Represents specific message types within the 'c1' choice, with methods for setting, serialization, and JSON conversion.

classes.name: ul_dcch_msg_type_c::msg_class_ext_c_
classes.description: Represents message class extension types, including nested types and methods for serialization and JSON.

classes.name: ul_dcch_msg_type_c::msg_class_ext_c_::c2_c_
classes.description: Nested types within message class extension, handling various message subtypes with serialization and JSON methods.

classes.name: ul_dcch_msg_s
classes.description: Represents the entire UL-DCCH message sequence, with methods for packing, unpacking, and JSON serialization.

methods.name: destroy_
methods.description: Destroys the current message type, freeing resources.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets the message type to a specific option.

methods.name: operator=
methods.description: Assignment operator for copying message types.

methods.name: set_c1
methods.description: Sets the message type to 'c1' and returns reference.

methods.name: set_msg_class_ext
methods.description: Sets the message type to 'messageClassExtension' and returns reference.

methods.name: to_json
methods.description: Serializes the message type to JSON.

methods.name: pack
methods.description: Serializes the message into bit buffer.

methods.name: unpack
methods.description: Deserializes the message from bit buffer.

methods.name: to_json
methods.description: Serializes the entire UL-DCCH message to JSON.
